watches.name: Floating Up
watches.description: Sometimes we find ourselves rising into a place we haven't been before. The view changes and new possibilities appear. And somewhere along the way, we begin to see ourselves and the world around us a little differently. Floating Up was created around that feeling of awakening. Three hot-air balloons drift above a mountain landscape, carried upward into an open expanse of natural shell that changes continuously with the light. The design is a celebration of movement, possibility and the courage to keep rising toward whatever comes next. Created in two distinct variations, Blue Yonder and Wind Dance, each version uses the natural character of the shell to create a completely different atmosphere. Blue Yonder Expansive blue Australian abalone creates the sky in Blue Yonder, with flashes of intense pink iridescence appearing as the shell catches the light. Milky movement within the abalone gives the sky remarkable depth, while warm brown mountains ground the landscape below. Three balloon silhouettes float into all that blue, giving Blue Yonder a feeling of openness and possibility, like looking toward a horizon that has suddenly become much larger. Wind Dance Wind Dance is the more expressive of the two variations. Blonde-tinted Pāua abalone forms the sky, chosen for the remarkable movement within the natural shell. Turquoise Agoya abalone creates the mountains, while wisps of the same turquoise sweep through the dial like currents of air. Some pieces of Pāua have dramatic swirls that appear to climb through the sky. Others move in entirely different directions. That natural variation is part of Wind Dance. No two skies will ever be exactly alike, and each dial takes its character from the shell used to create it. The Dial Each Floating Up dial is individually handcrafted from pieces of genuine natural shell that are selected, cut, cleaned and inlaid by hand. Because abalone is created by nature rather than manufactured to a specification, its color, iridescence and patterns vary from piece to piece. Those differences are especially beautiful in Floating Up. As the watch moves on the wrist, light travels across the shell, revealing colors and patterns that can disappear and reappear from another angle. Floating Up is a reminder that sometimes the most extraordinary part of moving forward is discovering how much more there is to see once we begin to rise. Case sizes: 38mm Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Kaleidoscope
watches.description: Some watches are defined by the image on the dial. Kaleidoscope is defined by the material itself. The Tiger Pearl shell in this watch has an extraordinary amount of color and refraction. Pink, purple, blue, green and gold ripple across the surface, shifting as the watch moves and the light strikes it from a different angle. At times it looks almost like colorful foil that has been swirled, crumpled, smoothed back out and captured beneath the crystal. For all that movement, the colors have an appealing softness. Paired with the clean lines of a gold rectangular case and easy-to-read numerals, the result is striking without being overpowering. There’s a little bit of wonder in watching Kaleidoscope come to life. A photograph can capture its colors, but the real magic happens in motion, as the light moves through the natural shell and the dial shifts from one beautiful combination of color to the next. Dial Composition The dial is handcrafted from Tiger Pearl shell tinted a translucent light blue. Beneath that color is the shell's natural crystalline structure, which reflects and refracts light through microscopic layers. As the angle of the watch changes, so does the path of the light through those layers. Pink, purple, blue, green and gold appear across the surface, sometimes glowing softly and sometimes flashing with surprising intensity. No printing or painted pattern creates the effect. The movement and variation come from the shell itself. Because Tiger Pearl is a natural material, every piece has its own pattern, color distribution and optical character. Each Kaleidoscope dial will be naturally one of a kind. Case size: Gold-Plated Rectangular Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Dreaming Fox
watches.description: The Story of the Dreaming Fox There are moments when we stop looking at where we are and begin imagining where we might go next. Dreaming Fox captures that moment of possibility. With its gaze fixed on the distance, the fox seems to be looking beyond the horizon, reminding us that every new chapter begins with curiosity, hope, and the courage to follow where our instincts lead. This is a watch for those who follow their own path. Dial Composition The fox is handcrafted from warm orange Tahitian abalone and inlaid into a vibrant blue Paua abalone background. The striking contrast between the two shells gives the dial both warmth and depth, while the fox’s vivid blue eye draws your attention and gives the piece a thoughtful, almost dreamlike expression. Because every piece of shell is naturally unique, each fox carries its own subtle color and personality. Available in 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Fireheart
watches.description: Many years ago, I created a horse watch called Wild and Free . The stallion was crafted from a rare ochre-colored shell that eventually became unavailable, making it impossible to recreate the design. For a time, I thought that chapter had come to an end. Then I discovered that the same horse, rendered in olive abalone against a field of glowing Tiger Pearl, became something entirely new. The horse hadn't changed but its spirit had. Fireheart celebrates that remarkable spirit, in addition to the stallion's strength and determination. Its fierce eye, flowing mane, and powerful presence create a sense of energy and forward motion. Horses have long symbolized freedom, courage, and the bond between instinct and purpose. Set against the fiery colors of the Tiger Pearl background, this horse feels alive with confidence and vitality. Process and Materials The dial is composed of 22 individually cut pieces of olive abalone shell, carefully inlaid by hand into the luminous Tiger Pearl background. As the light changes, the shell reveals flashes of gold, orange, green, and purple, creating remarkable depth and movement across the dial. A clear stone marks the 12 o'clock and a fire orange stone serves as the horse’s eye. The result is a watch that honors one of nature's most magnificent animals while embracing the bold energy that inspired its name. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Monarch - 38mm Swiss Automatic
watches.description: This monarch watch was created as a meaningful tribute to beauty, change, and the lasting presence of what we hold dear. The monarch butterfly, long admired for its grace and remarkable journey, is paired here with milkweed, the plant essential to its life cycle. Together they create a dial that feels both delicate and enduring, a small composition that carries a sense of remembrance and renewal. This watch was entered in the 2026 Grand Prix d’Horlogerie de Genève, the world’s most prestigious international watchmaking competition, in the Challenge category for watches under 4,500 CHF. Dial Composition The dial features a layered milkweed flower created from individually shaped pieces of purple abalone shell. The layered construction gives the flower depth and movement, while fourteen amethyst-colored cubic zirconia stones are set into the blossoms as tiny points of light, echoing the natural dark centers of milkweed flowers. The monarch butterfly is formed from orange Tiger Pearl shell selected for its natural orange, gold, and iridescent tones. A black metal overlay defines the wing structure and allows the distinctive monarch pattern to emerge. Orange cubic zirconia markers at 11, 12, 1, 3, 6, and 9 o’clock provide time indication while visually connecting the butterfly to the full composition. Rather than relying on paint or printed effects, the colors in the dial come from the natural shell itself. As the light moves, the dial shifts with flashes of orange, gold, green, blue, and violet. ----------------------------- The 38mm stainless steel case has a high-polish finish, screw-down crown, sapphire crystal, and sapphire exhibition case-back. Inside is a Swiss 26-jewel automatic-winding Sellita SW200-1 movement. For this special edition, the artistic story continues through the movement itself: the custom Celeste rotor is inlaid with orange Tiger Pearl shell, creating a direct connection between the front and back of the watch. The result is a complete artistic timepiece, with natural shell craftsmanship visible on both sides. Comes standard with a butterfly buckle and certificate of authenticity. Technical Specifications Sellita SW200-1 - 41 hour power reserve with c ustomized Celeste rotor. Perfect for this exhibition case back. Dimensions Case Width - 38mm excl. crown Case Thickness - 10.75mm incl. crystal Lug Width - 16mm Materials Case - 316L Stainless Steel. Combination of brushed and high polish surfaces. Front Sapphire Crystal - Anti-Reflective coating on both sides. Exhibition Back Sapphire Crystal - Anti-Reflective coating on both sides. Screw-down Crown Water Resistance 5 ATM / 50 Meters - In general, withstands splashes or brief immersion in water, but not suitable for swimming or bathing. Strap 16mm vegetable-tanned leather with a butterfly buckle (optional) or a stainless steel with white ceramic links bracelet.

watches.name: Blue Heron
watches.description: Blue Heron is a tribute to the steady presence and unmistakable posture of one of the most familiar birds along Northwest waterways. A heron has a way of standing completely still and at ease while remaining fully alert, with a beauty and presence that can make an ordinary moment feel memorable. This design focuses on that balance of patience, awareness, and grace. Wearing Blue Heron reminds us that stillness, even for a few minutes, can be grounding and life-changing. Dial Composition Blue tinted Australian abalone forms the sky, with green tinted mother of pearl below for the water. The heron combines black-lip abalone feathers, blue sapphire-toned shell in the lower feathers and crown, and cream Tahitian shell through the body. The beak and eye are anodized aluminum, while the cattails are hand painted in orange mica with UV detailing. Together, these materials create depth, movement, and natural variation, making each watch one of a kind. Case size: Rectangular Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Nostalgia
watches.description: The watch that started it all! Backstory In 2015, I was ready to start Celeste Watch Company. My debut watch was Nostalgia , featuring blue abalone shell inlaid in cherry wood. I wanted a watch that was going to connect me to the ocean and help me feel closer to my memories of playing on the beach, surfing and being a carefree kid in Hawaii. I called it Nostalgia because the shell symbolized the ocean and the wood symbolized the trees here in Oregon. The design had a calming effect while also merging where I have been to where I am. I felt like I could look at that watch and know that no matter what, everything was going to be alright. Process and Materials Crafted by hand, one version features an abstract wave of blue abalone inlaid into maple wood, while the other showcases a naturally pigmented abalone wave set against the same warm maple surface. The dial is intentionally minimal, with no time markers, allowing the materials and form to take center stage. The result is a clean, uncluttered composition that makes telling time simple and instinctive. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.description: Amethyst Crush Amethyst Crush, explores the depth and intensity of purple under pressure. Similar to a jewel, the dial reveals a saturated field of deep violet that shifts to flashes of luminous fuchsia as the light moves across its surface, with darker undertones that anchor the composition. The effect is dynamic but controlled, echoing the way color transforms when compressed by time and tide. Like the other watches in the Crush Collection, Amethyst Crush is about saturation and strength. It focuses on pure color and the natural energy locked within the material itself. The result is bold, dimensional, and quietly powerful. watches.name: Moonlight Mare - 38mm Swiss Automatic
watches.description: Moonlight Mare is a celebration of the Lunar New Year and the Year of the Fire Horse, which begins on February 17, 2026. Rare in the world of watchmaking, this horse is composed from twenty-nine individual pieces of gold mother of pearl, chosen for its luminous, moonlit quality and inlaid into either red or purple abalone shell. Woven through her mane are twenty-one carefully set jewels in shades of blue, silver, purple, and turquoise, placed as starlight that moves and glimmers on your wrist. Together, these details express a confident femininity in which softness and strength exist together. A true work of art, Moonlight Mare is crafted with the durability to be worn every day while remaining elegant enough for the most meaningful occasions. A clear CZ stone marks the twelve o’clock position at the top of the dial, serving as a subtle yet precise time marker. ----------------------------- The 38mm stainless steel case has a high polish finish and a screw-down crown. The sapphire crystal case-back reveals a Swiss 26 jewel automatic-winding Sellita SW200-1 with a customized Celeste rotor inside. Comes standard with a butterfly buckle and certificate of authenticity. Technical Specifications Sellita SW200-1 - 41 hour power reserve with c ustomized Celeste rotor with Côtes de Genève finish. Perfect for this exhibition case back. Dimensions Case Width - 38mm excl. crown Case Thickness - 10.75mm incl. crystal Lug Width - 16mm Materials Case - 316L Stainless Steel. Combination of brushed and high polish surfaces. Front Sapphire Crystal - Anti-Reflective coating on both sides. Exhibition Back Sapphire Crystal - Anti-Reflective coating on both sides. Screw-down Crown Water Resistance 5 ATM / 50 Meters - In general, withstands splashes or brief immersion in water, but not suitable for swimming or bathing. Strap 16mm Vegetable-Tanned Leather with Butterfly Buckle.

watches.name: Firewater
watches.description: Firewater is about the promise of a new day. Its warm, glowing dial mirrors the moment the sun breaks open over water, and hope makes you start to feel yourself again. The oranges, golds, purples and shifting turquoise echo the way challenges reshape us into something stronger, brighter, and more sure of who we are. This watch doesn’t symbolize the fire you walked through, it honors the glow you carry now. Every glance at your wrist is a reminder that your story didn’t end in the hard place, it began again, with hope. Dial Composition The dial is handcrafted from Tiger Pearl abalone shell, individually cut and color-infused to enhance its natural flame-like movement and iridescent undertones. Each piece is set into a gold-plated rectangular case and paired with a premium leather band. As with all natural shell, every Firewater dial is one of a kind, ensuring no two watches are ever exactly alike. Numbers are overlaid around the dial. Case size: Gold-Plated Rectangular Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Golden Gate Bridge - 42mm and 38mm Swiss Automatics
watches.description: Backstory, a personal note from Celeste: From the East Bay To My Wrist I grew up in the East Bay hills, where the mornings had a rhythm of their own. Before the world stirred too much, I would walk to school down our hill and see the Golden Gate Bridge. Not every day, of course. Some mornings, the fog hung low and the bridge disappeared completely. But on clear days, which were always cold (cold and clear was a "thing") there it was. Just to the right of the city and beyond the water, the red towers stood proud, like guardians watching over the Bay. Seeing it never got old. It didn’t matter how many times I saw it, that first glimpse, often as the sun was rising, always felt like a gift. That view and structure became a part of me. It was more than just a landmark. It stood for access, possibility, strength and grace. Even as a kid, I felt the quiet power of it - how it connected Marin and gave millions of people access to all of that vibrant energy, good food and things to do. As I grew up, I started to see how much of myself had been quietly shaped by its presence. "Bridges" have been a popular metaphor my whole life. Just recently, that memory came rushing back when I set out to handcraft a watch of the bridge. I didn’t just want to make something beautiful. I wanted to make something that had a story and held meaning. A piece of time you could wear that, like the bridge, was anchored in place but also enabled a gorgeous view (of your wrist) that could take your breath away. Every curve and contour of this watch is inspired by the Golden Gate Bridge. The structure, the lines, the strength - it's all there. But it’s not just a watch, it's also a piece of my childhood. A tribute to the view that shaped my mornings and my mindset. This is nostalgia, time, and identity just waiting for you to glance at your wrist, again and again. Elevate your wristwear with this abalone shell dial of the Golden Gate Bridge . A masterful fusion of Swiss precision, American crafts(wo)manship, and iconic design. This handcrafted one-off luxury timepiece pays homage to the Golden Gate Bridge — a symbol of engineering brilliance and timeless beauty. At the heart of the watch lies a Swiss automatic movement, celebrated for its reliability and elegance. The dial, a true work of art, is meticulously handcrafted with delicate pieces of abalone shell to reflect the sweeping lines and rust-red hue of the bridge set within a blue pearly iridescent sky. By layering and engraving subtle details, we captured the essence of San Francisco’s most enduring landmark. Every watch dial is crafted by hand, one at a time. The watch is then assembled and regulated in-house by Celeste herself, ensuring each timepiece reflects her meticulous attention to detail, deep-rooted passion for horology, and an unwavering commitment to authenticity. The case is offered in two sizes — 42mm and 38mm — both crafted from 316L stainless steel with a sapphire crystal on the front and backside exhibition case, for clarity and protection. Refined and profoundly symbolic, the Golden Gate Bridge is more than a timepiece — it’s a tribute to design, freedom, and the pursuit of excellence. Comes standard with a deployment clasp and certificate of authenticity. Technical Specifications Sellita SW200-1 - 41 hour power reserve with c ustomized Celeste rotor with Côtes de Genève finish. Perfect for this exhibition case back. Dimensions Case Width - 38mm or 42mm excl. crown Case Thickness - 10.75mm incl. crystal Lug Width - 16mm or 22mm Lug to Lug Distance - 49.86mm (42mm case) Materials Case - 316L Stainless Steel. Combination of brushed and high polish surfaces. Front Sapphire Crystal - Anti-Reflective coating on both sides. Exhibition Back Sapphire Crystal - Anti-Reflective coating on both sides. Screw-down Crown Water Resistance 5 ATM / 50 Meters - In general, withstands splashes or brief immersion in water, but not suitable for swimming or bathing. watches.description: Once upon a time, in a lush meadow full of colorful flowers and buzzing bees, there lived a little ladybug... Ladybugs are considered symbols of good fortune and protection. Seeing a ladybug is thought to bring luck, and some believe that if one lands on you, it’s a sign that good things are coming your way. Use it to not only bring good luck but also to celebrate and remember the little joys in life. Dial Composition The ladybug is the star of the dial, brought to life with hand-painted spots and eyes that add personality and detail to each watch. The tree is crafted from orange and brown-tinted Paua abalone, with olive-tinted abalone leaves creating depth and contrast. watches.name: Caw
watches.description: Embrace the spirit of adventure and travel with Caw , a bold statement piece that not only marks your path but reminds you that every journey is one of discovery. A crow's caw might be a warning, sign of upcoming changes, or messages from ancestors* while the compass ensures you can find your way home, no matter how far you venture out. Whether you're navigating life's twists and turns, plan to wander the world or are discovering new parts of yourself, Caw is the perfect fusion of vision and elegance—let it guide you on your journey—both through time and life. * ~ Essence of Symbols by Myra Logan Materials and Processes This dial features a golden mother of pearl background. At its center, a crow takes shape in rich purple abalone, warm brown mother of pearl, and a beak of black-stained maple. Beside it, a navigation symbol, crafted from fine brass shavings suspended in crystal-clear UV gel shows the way toward new horizons.

watches.name: Rainbow's End
watches.description: Backstory: When I was a child, I heard stories about leprechauns hiding their treasure at the end of the rainbow. I couldn't help but wonder how anyone could ever reach it, especially since rainbows didn't appear all the time. Each time it rained, I eagerly searched for a rainbow, hoping to figure out where it ended and if the spot was close enough for me to visit. More often than not, the rainbow’s end vanished into the ocean. As I grew older, the rainbow became a symbol of hope, always bringing a smile to my face. It represented the belief that a life-changing treasure was out there, waiting for someone to discover it. I dreamt of explorers and bold, fearless women who knew the way. I imagined myself playing and frolicking among the sparkling jewels and used the image as inspiration to chase my own dreams. Rainbow's End is a 3D dial with over 100 Swarovski crystals making up a treasure that sparkles with every turn of your wrist and reminds you of the jewels and richness in your life - your family, relationships, work, education, spirit, and/or home. Whatever makes you rich. MATERIALS Blue Sky: Australian Abalone tinted sky blue. Rainbow: Individually cut pieces of purple, blue, turquoise, yellow and red angel wing abalone. The Earth the cauldron sits on is green abalone tinted sepia. Cauldron: The cauldron itself is a dark purple angel wing abalone which reflects the light beautifully. Birds: Metal painted black. Treasure: The shimmering gold accents created with over 100 Swarovski pixie crystals are the highlight and focus of this dial. A 3D mix of gold, red, turquoise and violet crystals sparkle in the light and playfully call attention to the riches. Case size: 36mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Ripples
watches.description: Ripples is inspired by the quiet moments that change everything. Like a single pebble touching water and sending waves across the surface. This watch is a reminder that even the smallest actions can create beauty, momentum, and lasting impact in our lives. Each time you glance at your wrist, the shifting light and color echo the idea that every moment holds the potential to ripple outward with purpose and possibility. Dial Composition In a display of iridescent color, this exotic timepiece is created using rippled Awabi abalone. Like a pebble creating a ripple effect, the luminous sheen of the abalone is captured in layers of shimmering pinks, greens, and purples, reflecting light with every movement of your wrist. Unlike anything you've ever seen and truly gorgeous, the vibrant colors and rippling nature of the shell are unique to this rare type of abalone. Numbers are overlaid around the dial. Case size: 30mm Band size: 12mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Emerald Eyes
watches.description: The Story of Emerald Eyes Some materials don't need an elaborate design to make an impression. This watch celebrates the natural beauty of emerald-tinted abalone shell, allowing its color, depth, and changing light to take center stage. Elegant enough for special occasions and easy to wear every day, it is a piece that catches the eye without ever trying too hard. For those who appreciate the quiet confidence of natural materials. Dial Composition The dial is composed of a large mosaic of emerald-tinted abalone shell, with each piece individually fitted to create a clean, uninterrupted field of color. As the light moves across the shell, vibrant greens and natural iridescence reveal new patterns and depth from every angle. Simple overlaid numerals frame the dial, allowing the shell to remain the focus. Because abalone is a natural material, every watch has its own unique colors, markings, and character. Case size: 30mm Band size: 12mm Swiss Quartz

watches.description: Cigar Lips This is a timepiece that dares to be noticed. Bold lips, a smoldering cigar, and an unapologetic attitude come together in a design that radiates confidence, charisma, and allure. More than an accessory, it is a statement of individuality—sophisticated, rebellious, and impossible to ignore. This watch isn’t just worn; it’s owned, empowering you to express your authentic self with unapologetic style. Backstory Blog Post: Cigar Adventures Materials and Processes This dial makes a statement with its daring mix of materials and striking contrasts. Golden-tinted abalone forms the lips, set against teeth of shimmering mother of pearl and vivid pink anodized aluminum gums. Rich red abalone shapes the tongue, while Tahitian black-lip abalone creates the cigar and curling smoke. A glowing ember and metallic accents bring the design to life, all set against a mother of pearl backdrop that ensures the entire scene commands attention. Available in 38mm Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Zodiac Gemini Astrology
watches.description: Gemini is the zodiac’s ultimate cross-pollinator. It’s an eternal student, magician, and occasional trickster. Ruled by Mercury — the planet of communication and data processing — Gemini is endlessly inquisitive, comfortable with paradox, and distractible. The symbol for Gemini is the twins, and Gemini people can appear to be everywhere and nowhere at once. Defying the laws of gravity, space, and time, shape-shifting comes naturally. But as you flit between contradictions, it can be easy to lose who you are at the core. When distorted, this sign can become inconsistent, gossipy, and distracted. Remember to balance your endless stream of information with discretion and integrity. Process and Materials Crafted by hand, t he twin fish are created with crushed mother of pearl tinted purple. The yellow stars and gemini symbol are all inlaid in a Tahitian black-lip abalone background. Clear CZ stones serve as time markers around the dial. *The night sky varies in every timepiece based on inherent characteristic of the shell. Tinting serves to bring out the natural vibrancy of the colors. No two watches are ever identical. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Dolphin Dance
watches.description: Dolphins are known for their acrobatic displays with dramatic leaps and spins being an everyday performance. They can swim at speeds of up to 28mph and leap up to 30 feet in the air. They are intelligent and highly social, often swimming along with boats while also playing in their wakes. Playful and full of life, the Dolphin Dance timepiece celebrates the joy and freedom of the ocean’s most beloved creature. Known for their intelligence and grace, dolphins remind us to move through life with curiosity, connection, and lighthearted spirit. Dial Composition The dial features an abalone and mother of pearl dolphin leaping through a sky of Australian and Japanese abalone shells. Fluid motion is captured in shimmering layers of color. The water below glows in more abalone, while CZ stones sparkle above like stars or sunlight dancing on the waves. Together, these elements create a radiant scene that captures the beauty and energy of both dolphins and the sea. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Fireflies
watches.description: The enchanting dance of fireflies is like looking at tiny stars. These small, bioluminescent insects, also known as lightning bugs, twinkle a mesmerizing display of light. Their gentle glow, flickering on and off in a symphony of natural luminescence, creates an atmosphere that feels almost otherworldly. Fireflies use light primarily for communication, especially during mating season. Experiencing a night illuminated by fireflies often evokes a sense of nostalgia and wonder. Fireflies are bioindicators and thrive in environments free from light pollution and pesticides. Their sparkle is not only a delightful experience but also a reminder to live your best life by choosing an environment that lights you up. Dial Composition Petite chrome-colored Swarovski crystals sparkle like fireflies drifting across a warm evening sky, their light dancing over waves of angel wing abalone in shades of blue, fuchsia, purple, teal, and yellow. A single CZ stone at twelve serves as a guiding light, while a deeper 36mm case and fine silver base give the dial a subtle three-dimensional depth that brings the whole scene to life. Case size: 36mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Nautilus - Golden Circle
watches.description: The chambered nautilus is one of the oldest creatures known to live in the ocean. According to NOAA, fossil records show similar animals have existed for about 500 million years. Backstory: This design was created when a customer, celebrating his retirement, asked for a custom watch of the Universe's Golden Circle (ratio). Drawn to the spiral mathematical precision of a golden circle, and the fact that a Nautilus is a relative of the wondrous octopus, cuttle fish and squid, this watch was a pleasure to design and took on special meaning. To show the inner chamber shell as different pieces of the same color, I needed to create delicate wires, less than one inch from end to end, to separate each piece. Process and Materials: This dial features a background of light Tahitian abalone, with hues of silver, bronze, and ivory that shift in the light. The nautilus shell is inlaid from blue Paua and Tahitian abalones, while anodized aluminum frames and accentuates the inner chambers. Each piece is individually crafted, making every dial one of a kind. Available in 38mm Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Pearl Dragon - 38mm Swiss Automatic
watches.description: The Story of the Pearl Dragon The dragon has long been one of the most revered symbols in the lunar calendar, representing strength, wisdom, prosperity, and good fortune. Unlike the dragons of Western folklore, the Eastern dragon is a guardian and a bringer of positive energy. Pearl Dragon was created as a more graceful expression of that spirit. Flowing across the dial with confidence, she embodies strength balanced by elegance, reminding us that true power is often expressed with calm rather than force. Designed to be worn and enjoyed every day, Pearl Dragon is equally at home with jeans or evening wear. It is a celebration of artistry, symbolism, and the enduring beauty of natural materials. See our blog post on how this watch was created . -------------------------- Dial Composition Pearl Dragon is handcrafted from twenty individually cut pieces of natural shell and metal, each selected for its unique color and character. The dragon herself is formed from four varieties of abalone. Angel Wing abalone gives her body its luminous purple shimmer. Paua abalone provides the golden mane, olive accents, and natural blue-green eye. Pink Heart abalone forms the scales along her belly, while black-lip abalone creates her distinctive eyebrow. Her tongue, horns, and teeth are finely cut metal overlays, adding crisp detail and definition to the portrait. Three amethyst-colored stones mark the hours across the top of the dial, completing the composition with a touch of light. Because every piece of shell is naturally unique, no two Pearl Dragon watches are ever exactly alike. ----------------------------- The 38mm stainless steel case has a high polish finish and a screw-down crown. The sapphire crystal case-back reveals a Swiss 26 jewel automatic-winding Sellita SW200-1 with a customized Celeste rotor inside. Comes standard with a butterfly buckle and certificate of authenticity. Technical Specifications Sellita SW200-1 - 41 hour power reserve with c ustomized Celeste rotor with Côtes de Genève finish. Perfect for this exhibition case back. Dimensions Case Width - 38mm excl. crown Case Thickness - 10.75mm incl. crystal Lug Width - 16mm Materials Case - 316L Stainless Steel. Combination of brushed and high polish surfaces. Front Sapphire Crystal - Anti-Reflective coating on both sides. Exhibition Back Sapphire Crystal - Anti-Reflective coating on both sides. Screw-down Crown Water Resistance 5 ATM / 50 Meters - In general, withstands splashes or brief immersion in water, but not suitable for swimming or bathing. Strap 16mm Vegetable-Tanned Leather with Butterfly Buckle.

watches.name: Albuquerque Sky - 42mm Swiss Automatic
watches.description: To celebrate the 2023 Balloon Fiesta, Celeste released three new automatic one-of-a-kind hot air balloon watches, each stunning in it's own way with different combinations of colors. All three dials use varying combinations of Tahitian abalone to give the impression of blue skies, mountain passes and/or colorful balloons. October of each year is the International Balloon Fiesta in conjunction with the Rio Grande Arts and Crafts Festival. It's a magical event when 100-200 hot air balloons from all over the world simultaneously ascend in the early morning hours. People line the interstate and all the mountain roads waiting to see the mass ascension (take-off.) The fiesta is held in Albuquerque each year because of the infamous "Albuquerque Box". The Albuquerque Box is a weather phenomenon where the lowest winds are moving in one direction and the higher level winds are moving in another. Given the balloon pilots can't steer, this is beneficial to ballooning because by ascending or descending, the balloons can take off and land in almost exactly the same spot. Comes standard with a deployment clasp and certificate of authenticity. Balloon Fiesta Tan over Sandia Mountains (Tahitian abalone balloon and skies over the Sandia Mountains.) - One available Balloon Fiesta Tan in the Albuquerque Sky (Tahitian abalone balloon inlaid in sky tinted Tahitian abalone.) - Sold Out Balloon Fiesta Blue - Sold Out

watches.name: Paradise Sky
watches.description: The Story of Paradise Sky Some skies stay with us long after the day has ended. For one person, this dial may recall the colors of a tropical sunset reflected across calm water. For another, it may evoke the shifting ribbons of the northern lights. Like nature itself, the experience is personal, changing with the light and the memories we bring to it. A watch inspired by the wonder of looking up. Dial Composition The dial is created from Agoya abalone, a shell prized for its remarkable depth and natural iridescence. Although lightly tinted purple, the vivid blues, greens, pinks, and violets are inherent characteristics of the shell itself. The tint simply enhances the material's natural brilliance. As the light moves across the dial, new colors emerge from every angle, ensuring that no two watches are ever exactly alike. Simple overlaid numerals frame the composition, allowing the shell to remain the focal point. Case size: 30mm Band size: 12mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Pomegranate
watches.description: Backstory - This Pomegranate watch was commissioned for the 5-year celebration of the restaurant La Granada, here in Springfield. Granada means pomegranate in Spanish. We specifically put a cutting board and knife in the scene to signify the act of eating pomegranates rather than growing pomegranates. -------------------------------------- The pomegranate, long celebrated as a symbol of vitality, abundance, and health, takes center stage in this design. With every glance at your wrist, the watch becomes a quiet reminder of nature’s richness and the importance of nourishing both body and spirit. The scene is framed as though gazing through a window that opens onto a serene, beautiful sky creating an invitation to pause, reflect, and carry a sense of wellness with you throughout the day. Process and Materials The Pomegranate dial is brought to life through a striking blend of materials and meticulous craftsmanship. The background is formed from crushed mother of pearl pressed into a sheet, creating an intensified sparkle that catches the light with every movement. The pomegranates themselves are rendered in rich red–tinted abalone, accented by leaves of olive–tinted abalone. A window of turquoise–tinted mother of pearl opens the scene, while the cutting board is crafted from deep black-lip abalone. A finely detailed metal knife rests upon it, with the inside of a freshly cut pomegranate also gleaming in metal—adding both realism and contrast to the composition. Case: Rectangular in Rose Gold Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Cloisonné Octopus by Merry-Lee Rae
watches.description: Octopus in Cloisonné, completely hand done by Merry-Lee. 24K gold wirework. Only one available. Specifications: 32mm 316L hypoallergenic stainless steel case Sapphire Crystal Swiss Quartz Movement Water Resistant to 30M Lifetime Warranty for time keeping integrity 14mm black leather band -- Merry-Lee Rae is the two time winner of the Saul Bell Design Award for Enamels and winner of the MJSA Vision Award for Enamel Distinction . She began making jewelry as a teenager and her fascination with enamels and precious metals has been her lifelong passion. Her formal education was in mathematics and she fully intended to pursue a respectable career in Silicon Valley but as luck would have it, Merry-Lee got too busy doing what she loved and never had time to go to work. Instead, she found herself participating in the American Craft Council shows including Rhinebeck, Baltimore, West Springfield and San Francisco. She also participated in JCK Las Vegas in the Design Center. Cloisonné enameling has been her focus since 1976. She has honed her craft with the enthusiasm of an artist and the intensity of a mathematician creating works of intricate detail fusing glass on metal. She is guilty of thoroughly enjoying her work. "I see myself as a dedicated romantic, expressing love of life through my art. Using glass and gold, I create sunshine shouts of joy or murmurs of quiet remoteness. The resulting cloisonné jewelry is my voice. What really matters are the people who are touched by it in some way.” You can read more about Merry-Lee here .

watches.name: Navigator - Sea Turtle
watches.description: In Hawaiian and Polynesian cultures, the Honu (Hawaiian Green Sea Turtle) is considered a sacred and revered creature. It is believed to represent a navigator or guardian spirit that guides us safely through life's experiences and journeys. Honu can live up to 100 years and dive to depths of 1500 feet. Although endangered, thanks to long term collaboration between the state of Hawaiʻi, federal agencies like the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, and dedicated local volunteers, the Honu population has been increasing over the past two decades. Process and Materials This dial features a warm alder wood background, chosen for its fine grain and natural golden tones. Inlaid within are sea turtles crafted from Paua abalone, their shells tinted in shades of ocean blue. The iridescent patterns shift and sparkle in the light, evoking the graceful movement of turtles gliding through tropical waters. Case size: 38mm Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Watch Service Contract - Professional Watch Assembly
watches.description: Professional Watch Assembly You create the artwork. We handle the watchmaking. Your artwork is complete. Now it's time to transform it into a finished Swiss watch. Our Professional Watch Assembly service bridges the gap between enamel artistry and precision watchmaking. Every watch is assembled by hand in our Oregon studio and carefully inspected to ensure your artwork performs beautifully as a working timepiece. What We Do Every watch receives: Careful inspection of your completed dial Minor fitting adjustments when appropriate Permanent mounting of the enamel dial onto its brass support plate Installation of the Swiss movement Installation and alignment of the hour, minute, and seconds hands Complete case assembly Precision stem fitting Installation of the crown and water-resistance gaskets Final case sealing 72 hours of functional testing Only after the watch has successfully completed testing do we install the strap, issue its Certificate of Authenticity, and prepare it for shipment. Delivery Most watches are completed and returned within 2–3 weeks . Your finished watch arrives in a protective travel case and includes the same two-year warranty provided with every Celeste Watch. You may choose from a variety of vegetable-tanned leather strap colors including black, brown, tan, turquoise, olive, electric blue, coral, purple, red, and more. watches.name: Enamel Wells
watches.description: The Quartz Enamel Well Kit The Quartz Enamel Well Kit includes two fine silver enamel wells and an optional inspection and sanding jig. Each well is precisely formed to fit one of our quartz watch cases. Think of it as the canvas for your enamel artwork. The recessed "well" contains your design while providing the exact dimensions required for watchmaking. Although the wells were originally developed for cloisonné, they also provide an excellent foundation for painted enamel, translucent enamels, Mason stains, and other vitreous enamel techniques. The well simply establishes the size and fit of the dial. How you develop the surface and decorate it is entirely your own artistic decision. Two wells are included so you can experiment, refine your technique, or complete multiple finished dials. Automatic Enamel Wells Our automatic watch wells are available individually for artists creating larger, more elaborate enamel dials. These fine silver wells feature a lightly textured surface that enhances translucent enamels by creating greater depth and visual interest beneath the finished artwork. Unlike the quartz kit, automatic wells do not currently have a companion inspection jig, so artists should carefully verify thickness and diameter throughout the enameling process. Optional Inspection & Sanding Jig (32mm and 36mm Quartz) The optional jig removes much of the guesswork from fitting an enamel dial. If your finished dial fits the jig, it will fit the watch case. It allows you to verify: overall diameter finished thickness center hole size counter enamel thickness optional time marker placement The jig quickly shows whether additional sanding or firing is needed before your artwork is assembled into a watch. An automatic version is currently in development. Turning Your Artwork Into a Watch Once your enamel dial is complete, simply send it to us. We'll carefully inspect it, make any necessary technical adjustments, mount it onto its brass support plate, assemble the Swiss movement, install the hands, case the watch, pressure test it, and perform a full quality inspection before returning your finished timepiece. Most completed watches are returned within 2–3 weeks and include the same two-year warranty as every Celeste Watch. Why Precision Matters Every watch is engineered as a complete system. The movement, dial, hands, and case are all manufactured to precise tolerances and are designed to work together. Because of this, even small differences in diameter or thickness can affect the assembly of the watch. The Enamel Well System removes much of that uncertainty, allowing artists to concentrate on creating exceptional enamel while we handle the watchmaking. Specifications Fine silver wells Maximum finished dial thickness: 2.0 mm Available for 32mm, 36mm, 38mm quartz , and 38mm automatic Textured and smooth wells available Swiss Ronda quartz or Swiss automatic movements 316L stainless steel cases Scratch-resistant sapphire crystals Water resistance: 30 meters Choice of hands Metal or vegetable-tanned leather straps Protective travel case included Two-year warranty

watches.name: Up, Up and Away - Inlay
watches.description: Imagine floating quietly above vineyards, rivers and beautiful valleys. Our hot air balloon watch can take you to those special places. The Ballon Fiesta, Albuquerque, NM October of each year is the International Balloon Fiesta in conjunction with the Rio Grande Arts and Crafts Festival. It’s a magical event when 100-200 hot air balloons simultaneously ascend in the early morning hours. People line the interstate and all the roads from the mountains waiting to see the mass ascension (take-off.) The fiesta is held in Albuquerque, NM each year because of the infamous “Albuquerque box”. The Albuquerque Box is a weather phenomenon where the lowest winds are moving in one direction and the higher level winds are moving in another. This is beneficial to ballooning because then the balloon can take off and land in almost exactly the same spot. The colorful balloons hovering over the mountains are paua abalone inlaid in a blue Mother of Pearl tinted sky. In the Spanish language, "Celeste" means sky blue. Case sizes: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Cloisonné Nouveau Iris by Merry-Lee Rae
watches.description: 36mm Nouveau Iris in Cloisonné, completely hand done by Merry-Lee Rae with 24K gold wirework. This piece was a prototype while I was figuring out the special considerations for a watchdial. The number markers are not there but everyone knows where high noon is on a watchface right? Special pricing for this prototype piece. Only one available. Specifications: 36mm 316L hypoallergenic stainless steel case Sapphire Crystal Swiss Quartz Movement Water Resistant to 30M Lifetime Warranty for timekeeping integrity 16mm leather band or metal bracelet About the Artist Merry-Lee Rae is the two time winner of the Saul Bell Design Award for Enamels and winner of the MJSA Vision Award for Enamel Distinction . She began making jewelry as a teenager and her fascination with enamels and precious metals has been her lifelong passion. Her formal education was in mathematics and she fully intended to pursue a respectable career in Silicon Valley but as luck would have it, Merry-Lee got too busy doing what she loved and never had time to go to work. Instead, she found herself participating in the American Craft Council shows including Rhinebeck, Baltimore, West Springfield and San Francisco. She also participated in JCK Las Vegas in the Design Center. Cloisonné enameling has been her focus since 1976. She has honed her craft with the enthusiasm of an artist and the intensity of a mathematician creating works of intricate detail fusing glass on metal. She is guilty of thoroughly enjoying her work. "I see myself as a dedicated romantic, expressing love of life through my art. Using glass and gold, I create sunshine shouts of joy or murmurs of quiet remoteness. The resulting cloisonné jewelry is my voice. What really matters are the people who are touched by it in some way.” You can read more about Merry-Lee here .

watches.name: Yin Yang
watches.description: "In Ancient Chinese philosophy, yin and yang is a Chinese philosophical concept that describes how obviously opposite or contrary forces may actually be complementary, interconnected, and interdependent in the natural world, and how they may give rise to each other as they interrelate to one another. In Chinese cosmology, the universe creates itself out of a primary chaos of material energy, organized into the cycles of Yin and Yang and formed into objects and lives." ~Wikipedia THIS STUNNING YIN YANG TIMEPIECE IS AVAILABLE IN FOUR VIBRANT COLORS AND MATERIALS. TRADITIONAL BLACK In this yin yang design, harmony is reflected not only in its timeless symbol but in the materials themselves. The dark half is shaped from black-stained maple, grounding the design with the warmth of wood, while the light half shimmers in luminous mother of pearl, catching the light like water in motion. Only available in the 38mm size. ISLAND BLUE Get your island vibe going with this watch that brings together the land and the sea. In this timepiece, the Mother of Pearl represents the light of day while the ocean blue Paua abalone represents the abundance of water on Mother Earth. Available in the 35mm or 38mm sizes. WHITE BY WHITE Sometimes we thrive in the light of day and find our balance and solace not by acknowledging our differences but by shining our light and embracing our similarities. This timepiece is rare in that we only make it when the Mother of Pearl has unusual iridescence and sparkle. Only available in the 38mm size. PURPLE LOVE The color purple represents love, wisdom, bravery and spirituality. This timepiece represents finding balance in yourself and in your relationships. Available in the 35mm or 38mm sizes.

watches.name: Wonderland
watches.description: Why, sometimes I’ve believed as many as six impossible things before breakfast. ~Lewis Carroll, Alice in Wonderland This magical mushroom watch celebrates the wonder found in the forest. In the Pacific Northwest, mushrooms are a way of life. They are studied, foraged, and admired. This design honors that deep appreciation with flashes of red, green and blue on your wrist. It’s about curiosity and imagination as well as paying attention to what grows around us. Dial Composition This little mushroom forest comes to life against a shimmering black-lip abalone background that flashes blues, purples, and hints of pink as it catches the light. A winding stream of blue-tinted abalone flows along by green-tinted trees and warm ochre brown earth, setting the scene. The mushrooms steal the show, crafted from red-tinted abalone with hand-painted white spots, each resting on stems of luminous Tahitian abalone. Every element feels lively and full of movement, like a woodland moment frozen in time. Always unique, every watch is slightly different in colors and shading. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

Witches Brew continues the series with a moonlit scene of a witch tending her bubbling cauldron beneath the night sky. More playful than spooky, it celebrates the imagination, mystery, and traditions that make autumn such a magical time of year. Whether displayed each October or worn throughout the year, Witches Brew is a reminder that life is a little more fun when there's room for a bit of mystery. The witch, her cauldron, bats, and a tiny spider are finely cut metal overlays placed by hand above the shell background. The layered construction gives the dial depth while keeping the design clean and easy to read. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

Watching them move across open country feels both powerful and deeply human, a reminder of freedom, connection, and the enduring pull of untamed places. Wild and Free celebrates that spirit. The stallion's flowing mane and attentive gaze capture a sense of motion even while standing still, reminding us that freedom is as much a state of mind as it is a place. This is a watch for those who value adventure, self-reliance, and the courage to follow their own path. Peridot Swarovski crystals serve and time markers and a pink stone serves as the horse’s eye. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Tree Frog
watches.description: Leaping into the Light I've regularly attended and exhibited at shows in the Bay Area because it’s where I grew up and a wonderful opportunity to see family and visit my old stomping grounds. It’s a chance to feel nostalgic about how I became who I am - the influences of my youth that affected how I look at the world. I remember enjoying the energy of San Francisco and how everyone seemed to be pushing their limits intellectually, spiritually, culturally and energetically. I was a little fish that was fascinated by the people and their passions for living. On the drive home from a festival there, I began to think about this energy and how it exhausted me at one point in my life. In a time of coming of age, I never felt I was enough. I wasn’t strong enough, smart enough, thin enough and I didn’t have enough endurance. I felt invisible. I knew back then that for my future, I needed a way to assess if an environment was good for me. I needed a way to be in-touch with what would lift me vs. what would hold me down. Tree frogs are remarkable creatures, true indicators of the planet’s health. With skin that absorbs their surroundings, they’re highly sensitive to environmental change, making their presence a sign of balance and vitality. Beyond their beauty, these vibrant frogs help control mosquitoes, inspire medical advances, and even their tadpoles help keep our waters clean. By wearing the tree frog watch, would I be able to tell if the conditions were favorable for me? With a tree frog’s help, would I be able to always put myself in the most favorable light and circumstances? One of the most intricate inlay designs at Celeste Watch, this dial is composed of 31 pieces of abalone shell tinted in shades of brown, orange, olive, aqua, red, yellow, and purple, all inlaid in luminous Mother of Pearl. The result is a surface that shimmers and shifts with the light, mirroring the tree frog’s ever-changing brilliance and connection to its environment. It’s a celebration of vitality, balance, and the beauty of a healthy world. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Surfer Girl
watches.description: The ocean has a way of pulling people into the present moment. This Surfer Girl design reflects the search for the right wave — not just in the water, but in life. Some waves pass by. Others ask to be ridden. Like surfing itself, life is shaped by instinct, timing, energy, and the choices we make along the way. The movement of water reminds us that no two moments are exactly alike. There is rhythm, connection, uncertainty, and joy in learning when to move forward and when to simply watch the tide roll through. Surfer Girl is inspired by presence, freedom, and the feeling of being fully alive. Dial Composition Surfer Girl is unusual in that it combines both inlay and layered construction within the same dial. The white shell is mother of pearl, a material that naturally carries soft flashes of pink, green, and violet. The wave is formed from blue-tinted Paua abalone, carefully cut so the two materials meet seamlessly along the curve of the water. The surfer herself is cut from metal and placed by hand over the iridescent mother of pearl background. This layered construction gives the dial depth and creates a subtle three-dimensional effect as the light moves across the surface. Clear cubic zirconia stones serve as time markers on the dial. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Yorkie Dog Breed Watch
watches.description: Take your Yorkie everywhere! The bond we have with our pets is more important than ever. They give unconditional love and accept you for who you are. What could be better than taking them with you everywhere, everyday, and smiling at your wrist 500 times per day? Our pets have amazing power and thinking about them or being with them is so heartwarming. The pop art rainbow dog portrait is printed directly on the Mother of Pearl giving it an unmatched iridescence and depth of color. In the sun, the Mother of Pearl sparkles and displays a rainbow of beautiful colors that compliment your every outfit. It's the perfect watch for every occasion: It comes in two sizes - 35mm or 38mm; You can choose your favorite color for your band; This watch runs on a Swiss movement so it keeps good time; A sapphire crystal ensures it looks good year after year; It's water resistant to 30M for the 35mm size, and 50M for the 38mm size; Bands come in short or long lengths; Batteries are free; Every watch comes with a two-year warranty.

watches.name: Summer Wind
watches.description: Summer Wind is about finding your spirit. It’s about feeling free with the wind blowing through your hair. It represents the freedom of youth and the search for being your best self—doing what you like to do and feeling the happiness and energy of living in the moment. It evokes the days of dreaming big dreams, of holding on to hope, and choosing your path as you bike along the beach or city streets. Summer Wind is also more. It represents a fresh and innovative way of making watches. It’s not an inlay. It’s not an overlay. I’m calling it a “layered” or “stratified” design that is opening doors and creating new inspiration with its original combination of materials and processes. There is nothing like this anywhere. Dial Composition The background beach scene is printed directly on mother of pearl which gives it an unmatched iridescence and depth of color compared to other printed watch dials. In the sun, the mother of pearl sparkles and adorns you with a rainbow of beautiful colors that go with your every style and attitude. The mother of pearl directly connects you to “her”—you’re riding along the beach with the wind in your hair. My heroine on the bike (shall we call her Summer?), with wheels smaller than the diameter of a marble, is cut out in metal and meticulously placed, by hand, on top of the iridescent mother of pearl background. Raised brown-tinted abalone shell gives the dial a 3D effect and serves as the land she lightheartedly rides upon. Golden cubic zirconia stones sparkle as time markers at the top of the dial. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Rise
watches.description: "New beginnings are often disguised as painful endings." — Lao Tzu Rise is about finding balance and rising up against adversity. It symbolizes swaying in high winds while remaining grounded, a reminder that true strength comes from flexibility. This watch is meant to inspire resilience and grace in the face of life’s challenges. This radiant nature-inspired timepiece features a tree and leaves handcrafted from abalone shell, delicately inlaid into shimmering Mother of Pearl. Each abalone piece is surrounded by a soft, milky backdrop, creating a striking contrast. The dial shimmers with an iridescent sparkle, revealing hints of purple, pink, and green as it catches the light. BACKSTORY Every Celeste watch has a story. When I first developed my Rise watch I was going through a hard time in my life. I labeled it my adversity watch but the meaning was about finding strength and rising up against whatever was holding you down. It was a symbol of bending without breaking. Although I would naturally be drawn to creating a tree in wood, I used shell specifically because it sparkled in the light and I wanted to sparkle too. The watch became my connection to that part of me that is able to keep my feet on the ground while simultaneously swaying in high winds. Available in 30mm or 35mm sizes Band sizes: 12mm for 30mm case size or 16mm for 35mm case size. Swiss Quartz

watches.description: The plumeria flower, with its white, yellow, orange or fuchsia pinwheel petals, represents birth and love. It can be a symbol of spring and new beginnings. Abundant and adored throughout the islands of Hawaii, the flower is considered positive and hopeful. In the Hawaiian culture, the plumeria can be used to symbolize a woman’s romantic status when worn in the hair. Just like a ring, when worn on the left side, she is married and the right side indicates she is single. PROCESS AND MATERIALS This beautiful watch is skillfully crafted from 27 pieces of Mother of Pearl and abalone shells that were carefully inlaid in the Mother of Pearl background. The leaves are olive tinted abalone, the flowers are mother of pearl with yellow mica dust and the buds are mother of pearl with fuchsia mica dust. Case size: 30mm Band size: 12mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Northern Lights
watches.description: This design was inspired by the aurora borealis and aurora australis — luminous displays created when charged particles from the sun collide with the Earth’s atmosphere near the magnetic poles. These lights move in ribbons, arcs, and drifting curtains across the sky, appearing in colors that range from pale green and pink to deep violet and blue. Like the aurora itself, the shell changes constantly as the light moves across its surface. Dial Composition The shifting colors in this dial are created from the rim of Awabi abalone shell from Japan. Although the shell is tinted with purple and turquoise tones, the vivid flashes of color are natural characteristics of the material itself. The tinting simply brings forward the shell’s inherent depth and vibrancy. A clear 2mm stone marks the 12 o’clock position like a distant point of light in the night sky. Awabi abalone, sometimes called sea snail, is considered endangered, so Celeste Watch Company uses only reclaimed waste shell. The shades, markings, and color variations are natural characteristics of the material, making every dial unique. Case size: 30mm Band size: 12mm Swiss Quartz

They are confident and deeply connected to the land around it while moving with purpose and presence. Papa Bear was designed for people who feel connected to the outdoors and appreciate things made from natural materials. The clean alder wood background gives the dial a grounded simplicity, while the abalone shell brings just enough depth and movement as the light changes across the surface. Familiar from the moment you put it on, Papa Bear reflects a steady and capable kind of confidence. Process and Materials The bear is cut from root beer colored abalone shell and set into an engraved landscape of mountains, trees, and a blue-tinted abalone river. The combination of wood and shell feels classic, rugged, and distinctly Pacific Northwest. This special watch dial is both an inlay and overlay at the same time.

Some wear it because they grew up riding in one, chasing sunsets and road trips with the windows down. Others wear it because they’re restoring one now, bolt by bolt, bringing a classic back to life. This watch celebrates that connection, the stories, the work, and the joy that comes from the journey. Easygoing and full of character, it’s a timepiece made for people who appreciate the road behind them and the one still ahead. Dial Composition The microbus is meticulously crafted from 12 pieces of tinted Paua abalone and Mother of Pearl, each one carefully inlaid into a rich green abalone background. The colors shift and glow like sunlight on a long summer drive, bringing the bus to life with depth and movement. Some of the inlay pieces are smaller than a grain of rice, a quiet testament to the precision and patience behind every dial. Case size: 38mm Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Howl
watches.description: A Fond Farewell Howl was one of the very first designs I ever created and has been with me almost from the beginning of my journey as a watchmaker. What started as a wolf and moon inlaid in wood evolved over the years into new interpretations in black-lip abalone and, later, a striking design with a forest of metal overlay. As my skills grew, Howl grew with me. This original design has now reached the end of its journey. The remaining watches are the last that will ever be made. Once they find their homes, this chapter of Howl will become a lasting part of Celeste history, while its spirit continues to inspire the designs that followed. This striking “Howling at the Moon” timepiece makes you want to find your pack. Howl Like You Mean It In this dial, a mother of pearl wolf and moon are surrounded by an iridescent Tahitian black-lip abalone sky. With hues of turquoise, purple, pink and blue the CZ stone time markers light-up the night and serve as twinkling stars in the sky all around the dial. Case sizes: 35mm or 38mm Band sizes: 16mm or 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Endless Summer
watches.description: The Story of Endless Summer Some summers stay with you long after they end. Endless Summer was inspired by the easy rhythm of beach towns, salt air, and days shaped by the tide and the sun. The retro surfboard resting along the shoreline brings to mind the simple, warm, and full of possibility kind of summers people return to in their memories. Comfortable and understated, Endless Summer is a reminder to slow down, stay present, and hold onto the moments that feel timeless. Process and Materials In this design, the beach scene is printed directly onto natural maple wood, allowing the grain of the material to remain part of the artwork itself. The wood gives the watch warmth and character while reinforcing the relaxed, vintage feel of the piece. Available in 38mm Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Stargazer
watches.description: Since ancient times, gazing at the star-studded night sky has been part of life. Astronomy is the oldest scientific discipline and art pieces with moons and stars date back thousands of years. We have counted stars, tracked constellations and navigated ships under them. The moon provides light on dark night and tells the passing of time. Star Gazer is about the moment you stand at the edge of possibility, when the night sky feels endless, and your dreams feel close enough to touch. It speaks to those beginning a new journey, caught between reflecting on the path behind and preparing to set the world alight with what comes next. Under its glimmering stars, time feels less like minutes and hours, and more like an open horizon waiting to be explored. PROCESS AND MATERIALS In the Star Gazer timepiece, a sky of mosaic blue mother of pearl meets the swirling iridescence of a Tahitian black-lip abalone Earth. A luminous mother of pearl moon hangs above, while a solitary figure looks upward, lost in the wonder of a boundless dream. Cubic zirconia stones glimmer like distant stars, guiding both time and imagination. Meticulously crafted by hand, each piece is a singular work of art, no two will ever be the same. Case sizes: 35mm or 38mm Band sizes: 16mm or 20mm Swiss Quartz

This watch captures that quiet moment of wonder, a reminder to pause, dream, and let your imagination wander among the stars. Each piece is handcrafted with care, making every La Luna as unique as the night sky itself. The cat and time markers are finely cut metal overlays that rest on the shell’s surface. In the light, the dial shimmers softly, capturing the serenity of moonlight and the companionship of a watchful cat beneath the stars. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Compass Rose
watches.description: The Compass Rose is a figure used to display the orientation of the four (north, south, east and west) cardinal directions on a map, compass or nautical chart. It symbolizes old-fashion navigation and can help you find your way to anywhere. Wearing this watch can remind you that you are safe and know the way home. Process and Materials Available in vibrant shades of red, green, blue, or yellow, this timepiece is set against a warm alder wood backdrop, its surface engraved with the four cardinal directions. At its heart blooms the “Rose Petals” motif, inlaid with the luminous shimmer of abalone shell and mother of pearl. A single 2mm cubic zirconia marks the North Star, while smaller, jewel-toned stones dance across the dial, adding a touch of sparkle to every glance. Available in 38mm Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Song Bird
watches.description: A Fond Farewell This was the very first bird watch I ever created, marking the beginning of what would grow into the Celeste birds collection. For nearly a decade, this little songbird has reminded us to slow down and appreciate the simple beauty found in nature. It's having a quiet moment on a branch enjoying a blooming hibiscus. There is joy in noticing the world around us. Now, after many wonderful years, this design is taking its final bow. The remaining watches are the last that will ever be made. Once they find their homes, this cherished design will become part of Celeste history. The Songbird watch celebrates the beauty and sweet spirit of nature. Each dial captures a bird paused in song, surrounded by light and color. Inspired by the joy and freedom that birds bring to our world, this design is a tribute to songs on the wind and the artistry found in every detail of nature. Dial Composition This dial is handcrafted with 14 pieces of abalone shell in shades of yellow, purple, olive, and grey, inlaid into a soft, milky Mother of Pearl background. Clear CZ stones mark the hours, adding subtle sparkle that echoes the shimmer of the shell. With every turn of your wrist, the colors shift and dance, creating a timepiece that sings, just like the bird. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Peacock
watches.description: With amazing flashes of color, this gorgeous peacock watch will turn heads! Traditionally, the tail of a peacock conveys confidence and strength while the "eyes" in the feathers boost your protection and awareness. Therefore, when you wear this watch, you will feel elegant, strong, and protected. Process and Materials The Peacock watch is offered in two exquisite styles. In the yellow-breasted design, the body shimmers in ocean-blue–tinted abalone, while the sweeping tail feathers, inlaid in luminous mother of pearl, glow with iridescence. Jonquil CZ stones mark the hours at 12, 3, 6, and 9, their golden sparkle echoing the warmth of the plumage. The purple-breasted style pairs the same ocean-blue–tinted abalone body with natural abalone tail feathers, each feather set into mother of pearl for a play of color that shifts with the light. Six petite Swarovski crystals, in a rainbow of hues, grace the crown atop the peacock’s head—like a jewel for a jewel. Case size: Rectangular Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Screech - The Owl
watches.description: Owls are symbols of wisdom, intuition, and quiet strength. Known for their keen sight and soundless flight, they are often seen as guardians and messengers—watchful observers of the world around them. Backstory: Many years ago, I lived for a year on Whidbey Island in Washington State. My little dog weighed about eight pounds, and every night before bed, I’d let her out onto the back lawn — forty feet of open grass that met the edge of a dense forest. It became our quiet routine. One evening, I noticed an owl perched at the tree line, watching us. I could hardly believe how close it was. When our eyes met, it felt like a silent understanding passed between us. The next night, just before I opened the door for my dog, the owl landed in the same tree, waiting. Clearly, it was no coincidence. We met eyes again — both of us aware of the other’s intentions. Mine was to protect my tiny dog; the owl’s, perhaps, to see if I would. This continued for several weeks. I began to expect the owl, even look for it, and came to appreciate its company in that strange, unspoken way that only nature allows. And then, one night, it was gone. Still, I think of that owl often — a quiet reminder of awareness, patience, and respect for the wild. Dial Composition Each Screech timepiece is meticulously handcrafted, balancing artistry with precision. The dial features a rare brown Mother of Pearl shell with natural hues of green, pink, and purple that shift with every glance. The owl’s form is a metal overlay, hand placed with care, creating depth and contrast against the iridescent background. Every surface is polished to capture light like feathers in motion, making this watch both exotic and elegant, a reminder of quiet wisdom and connection to the natural world. Case sizes: 35mm or 38mm Band sizes: 16mm or 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Sea Otter
watches.description: A KEYSTONE SPECIES Sea otters are a keystone species, playing a vital role in the health of our coastal ecosystems. By feeding on sea urchins and other invertebrates, they protect the kelp forests that provide food and shelter for countless marine animals. Once hunted nearly to extinction for their luxurious fur, their populations dropped to only a few thousand worldwide. Thanks to conservation efforts and reintroduction programs, sea otters have made a remarkable recovery, though they remain endangered today. This timepiece celebrates their story and their beauty. Every glance at the otter on your wrist is a reminder of the balance they help maintain in the ocean, and of the importance of protecting the natural world we all depend on. Process and Materials This sea otter timepiece is a carefully crafted composition of fourteen pieces of abalone shell and Mother of Pearl. The background shimmers in aqua-tinted Mother of Pearl, while the otter comes to life through a mix of richly colored shells: pink heart abalone for the arms and hands, brown abalone for the clam on its stomach, tortoise shell abalone for the head, and a blend of brown Mother of Pearl, paua abalone, and black-lip abalone for the body. Available in 35mm Band sizes: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Pot of Gold
watches.description: Backstory: Back when I was an engineering educator (before I opened Celeste Watch Company) I worked with SeaPerch , an underwater robotics program that equips students, educators, and parents with the resources they need to build an underwater robot. In the process of working with them, to inspire kids to pursue a career in engineering, I wrote a book called, The Maritime Engineer: Careers in Naval Architecture and Marine, Ocean and Naval Engineering. During the course of researching and writing this book I fell head over heels in love with a book called Ship of Gold in the Deep Blue Sea about an ocean engineer who found a ship that sank 200 miles from the Carolinas shore while carrying over $1 billion of gold (21 tons) back in 1857. I loved it so much that I read it twice. The story lit up my imagination and spirit of innovation. The engineer who designed the equipment to find, and then salvage the wreck, was relentlessly innovative and adventurous. It was the story about his dream of recovering the biggest treasure on record and I was enamored with his passion. The story made me want to hunt for underwater treasure too (or at least chase my dreams.) Pot of Gold has been years in the making with countless revisions. The very nonstandard watch dial is triple the thickness of my usual dials and required coming up with an entirely different technique to have a functional watch. But at long last, we can all wear the treasure we seek. Treasure that sparkles with every turn of your wrist and reminds you of the jewels and richness in your life - your family, relationships, work, education, spirit, and/or home. Whatever makes you rich. PROCESS AND MATERIALS Over 100 Swarovski crystals are the highlight and focus of this dial. A 3D mix of gold, red, turquoise and violet crystals sparkle in the light and playfully call attention to the treasure. The treasure chest itself is wood with metal rails that are then inlaid in an ocean of turquoise (ocean background) and blonde (ocean floor) abalone shell. Seaweed and fish add to the underwater scene and compliment the dial. Case size: 36mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Orca
watches.description: The killer whale, also known as orca, is the ocean’s top predator. Orcas, also known as killer whales, are actually the largest members of the dolphin family. They’re found in every ocean on Earth, from the icy waters of the Arctic and Antarctic to warm tropical seas. Orcas are apex predators, meaning nothing in the ocean preys on them, and they’re incredibly smart hunters. Some pods feed only on fish, while others specialize in hunting seals, dolphins, or even whales. Each group has its own hunting style and preferred foods, which makes them endlessly fascinating to watch and study. A true miniature masterpiece, this orca watch is meticulously crafted from 12 individual pieces of abalone, Mother of Pearl, and fine wood. The sky is a soft, light blue Mother of Pearl, the ocean shimmers in aqua-tinted shell, and the wave glistens with sparkle Mother of Pearl. Pink heart abalone forms the distant mountains, while the orca itself is brought to life with a striking combination of black-stained maple and luminous Mother of Pearl. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Sea Turtle
watches.description: A Fond Farewell This was the very first sea turtle watch I created. For nearly a decade it has been part of the Celeste collection, introducing countless collectors to my love of the ocean. Now, as this chapter comes to a close, the remaining watches are looking for their forever homes. Once they're gone, this design will become part of Celeste history. In Hawaii, the sea turtle “Honu” is sacred and a symbol of good luck. For Hawaiians, the Honu represents the navigator and the eternal link between people, the land and the sea. A symbol of good luck, this sea turtle is created with 16 tiny pieces of mother of pearl and abalone shell tinted five different colors. A clear CZ stone serves as a distinctive time marker at the 12. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Hummingbird
watches.description: The hummingbird embodies endurance, lightness of being, and joy. In Aztec legend, these radiant birds symbolized rebirth—warriors who fell in battle were said to return as hummingbirds, their spirits renewed in flashes of color and light. Their presence reminds us to savor life’s sweetness, to move with grace, and to find strength in every small moment. Dial Composition Handcrafted from 17 pieces of luminous abalone and Mother of Pearl, this dial radiates pure joy. Each wing and petal reflects a different hue of the ocean—soft pinks, violets, and greens that shimmer and shift with the light. The Mother of Pearl encircles the design in a gentle, milky glow, grounding the brilliance of the shell. A single clear stone at twelve marks the passage of time, a quiet reminder of stillness amid motion. The result is a radiant celebration of beauty, balance, and spirit. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Hook 'Em
watches.description: The Story of Hook 'Em There is something about standing in a river with a fly rod that slows the world down. Hook ’Em was designed for those who understand the rhythm of moving water, early mornings outdoors, and the quiet focus that comes with fishing. The clean alder wood background gives the dial a grounded simplicity, while the abalone trout brings depth and natural color as the light moves across its surface. Hook ’Em is a reminder of rivers, fresh air, and the moments spent doing what you love. Process and Materials The fish is cut from abalone shell and inlaid in alder wood with an engraved landscape of mountains and trees in the background. A fishing hook and line are layered overlays, giving the design movement without losing its clean, classic feel.
