watches.name: Giraffe
watches.description: Long before women were widely recognized in the field of wildlife research, Canadian biologist Anne Innis Dagg traveled alone to South Africa to study giraffes in the wild. Her work helped lay the foundation for modern giraffe research and conservation, even though much of her contribution went unrecognized for decades. This watch was created in honor of Anne’s pioneering spirit and enduring love for giraffes. Dial Composition The dial was handcrafted to reflect the warmth and character of the giraffe itself. Brown-tinted mother of pearl forms the background, while the giraffe is shaped from luminous Tahitian abalone with brown Paua abalone spots inlaid. Red or olive flowers bloom across the dial, each accented with a sparkling CZ stone that catches the light as the watch moves. Set within a rose gold barrel-shaped case, the design feels playful, joyful, and full of personality. It is nearly impossible to look at this little giraffe without smiling. Case size: Rectangular Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Galloping Goddess
watches.description: There is a certain feeling that comes from riding a horse at full stride. The world gets quieter, the distractions fall away, and all that remains is movement, focus, and freedom. Galloping Goddess celebrates that feeling. The rider and horse move together with confidence and trust, carrying a sense of momentum that is both powerful and joyful. It is a reminder to move forward, embrace adventure, and enjoy the journey as much as the destination. A watch for those who feel most alive when they are moving toward what they love. Dial Composition The dial begins with a luminous mother of pearl background that reflects soft flashes of pink, green, and violet as the light changes across the surface. Flowing leaves of natural abalone shell are inlaid into the mother of pearl, creating a sense of movement and wind. The rider and horse are formed from a finely cut metal overlay placed by hand above the shell background. This layered construction adds depth to the dial and gives the design a subtle three-dimensional presence. Together, the shell and metal create a scene that feels both graceful and full of motion. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Bliss
watches.description: This woman and cat timepiece is about being meditative and in the moment. Meditation helps you build emotional resilience, which means you are able to bounce back from bad moods more quickly and are less likely to become upset. Through regular meditation, we can observe and accept our own emotions, and are better able to recognize how those around us are feeling. Beautifully crafted with iridescent shell, the dial shows the strong connection between mindful meditation, an improved spiritual connection and bliss. Process and Materials The iridescent and sparkly white shell on the dial is Mother of Pearl. Mother of Pearl can have hues of purple, pink and green within it. The most common shimmery color is pink but shell is an organic material so the variation in shades is impossible to predict. The moon inside the Mother of Pearl is golden Mother of Pearl and the rock that the woman and cat are sitting on is mosaic abalone which is colorful pieces of abalone pressed into a sheet. The woman and cat companion are cut from metal and overlaid on the golden Mother of Pearl moon. Available in 35mm and 38mm Band sizes: 16mm or 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Breathe
watches.description: This Breathe watch symbolizes the connection between the woman on the dial and the tree, as well as our deeper connection to each other, to Mother Earth, and to gratitude. Inspired by the foundational practice of mindful breathing, it encourages calm, focus, and balance throughout your day. Staying grounded and in tune with nature is at the heart of this design, making it a timepiece that inspires presence with every glance. The Yoga Goddess dial features an abalone tree beautifully inlaid in luminous Mother of Pearl. The Goddess herself is crafted from metal and overlaid on the Mother of Pearl, creating a layered, tactile effect. In sunlight, the Mother of Pearl shimmers with iridescent hues, reflecting a rainbow of colors that harmonize with any style. The dial draws you in, connecting you to her serene presence in the tree pose beneath the vibrant abalone tree. Available in Silver and Rose Gold Rectangular Cases Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Sasq-Watch
watches.description: This amazing wrist art is an inlay, overlay, and marquetry at the same time. The dial features a cherry wood background engraved with trees and mountains, evoking the dense forests where legends are born. The sky is crafted from Tahitian black-lip abalone, the moon from luminous Mother of Pearl, and Bigfoot himself from abalone tinted a deep ochre brown. Butted up next to each other, we have Bigfoot roaming the forest under a full moon. HANDCRAFTED Each dial is crafted by hand in our studio in Springfield, Oregon. No two Bigfoots ever have the same mottled abalone patterns, the black lip abalone sky never has the same iridescence or reflection of light, and the engraved cherry wood has differing grains. Handmade, each watch is different from the others. BACKSTORY Camping out in the Pacific Northwest, I heard a noise in the brush outside of my tent. Something big. Was it a bear? Had I stored my food properly? As I peered out from the flimsy safety of my tent, I couldn’t see anything in the darkness of the forest. Convinced that the noise had passed, I was about to go back to my book when I heard it again. A footstep and brush being moved. My heart started racing. Peering outside again, I saw something move out of the corner of my eye. Chills raced down my spine. It was big—larger than a man and not the right form for a bear. It lumbered. What was it? My eyes desperately searched the outside terrain to identify it. Clearly someone…or something…was out there! I’ll never know exactly what visited my campsite that night but I’ve come to believe that perhaps Bigfoot is not a myth. Could he be alive and well in the Pacific Northwest? This timepiece reminds me to trust my instincts and that there are things in this world I can appreciate without tangible facts or a full understanding. GearJunkie Review of Sasq-Watch Case size: 38mm Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Endless Entertainment
watches.description: Some cats can watch birds for hours and never get bored. This playful design features a curious cat perched in a tree while three little birds keep a careful eye on her from above. There is no rush, no real danger, just the quiet amusement of animals entertaining one another. A lighthearted watch for cat lovers and anyone who appreciates everyday moments of entertainment. Process and Materials The dial is built on a mother of pearl background that softly reflects the light beneath the scene. Overlaid on top is a finely cut metal silhouette of the tree, birds, and cat, giving the design depth and clean definition. The layered construction keeps the watch simple, easy to wear, and full of personality. Because natural mother of pearl varies from piece to piece, each dial carries its own subtle color and character. Available in 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Coon Cat
watches.description: The Story of the Rainbow Coon Cat People who love cats understand how much personality they can bring into a home. This rainbow cat watch was created as a playful reminder of the comfort, humor, and presence that cats bring into everyday life. Bright, colorful, and full of character, this design has a cheerful energy that naturally makes people smile. An easygoing watch for cat lovers who enjoy carrying a little personality with them throughout the day. Process and Materials This colorful Maine Coon portrait is printed directly onto natural mother of pearl, allowing the shell beneath the artwork to softly reflect the light. The iridescent surface gives the dial depth and movement while enhancing the vivid rainbow tones of the cat itself. The combination of color and luminous shell creates a playful design that feels bright, expressive, and easy to wear. Because mother of pearl is a natural material, each dial carries its own subtle variations in color and character. It's the perfect watch for every occasion: It comes in two sizes - 35mm or 38mm; You can choose your favorite color for your band; This watch runs on a Swiss movement so it keeps good time; A sapphire crystal ensures it looks good year after year; It's water resistant to 30M for the 35mm size, and 50M for the 38mm size; Bands come in short or long lengths; Batteries are free; Every watch comes with a two-year warranty.

watches.name: Pelican
watches.description: Graceful, strong, and endlessly resourceful, the pelican is a symbol of teamwork and perseverance. Watching these magnificent birds dive, soar, and fish in unison inspired this design and is a tribute to community, balance, and the joy of shared purpose. My fascination began decades ago on a California beach, watching hundreds of pelicans working the water together in a breathtaking feeding frenzy. That sense of wonder has stayed with me ever since. This timepiece captures the spirit of those moments and is a reminder to stay curious, connected, and in love with the natural world. Dial Composition To bring the pelican’s strength and grace to life, this dial is composed of 14 pieces of shell, each one carefully inlaid into an ocean-green abalone background. The rock glows in soft pink heart abalone, while the beak, wings, chest, and head are crafted from tinted abalone in complementary tones. The neck shimmers in Mother of Pearl, and the reeds and feet gleam with anodized aluminum, adding a cool metallic contrast. Together, these elements capture the quiet beauty of the shoreline and the enduring spirit of this remarkable bird. Case size: 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Seahorse
watches.description: Seahorse lovers arise! These beauties are made of 27 pieces of abalone shell. They are intricate, exotic and an excellent compliment to your love of the sea. Encased in a barrel shaped case, stones that match the seahorse are set at the 12, 6 and 9 to artfully blend the seahorse in the ocean. BACKSTORY When Marge walked into the boutique, she talked of a life of diving remote islands in search of seahorses and other rare and beautiful aquatic life. She showed me pictures she had taken with her underwater camera. I had the privilege of seeing so many tiny rare seahorses that most of the world never gets to see. She brought me into her passion by explaining where she goes, several times a year, to find them. When she was first looking for a watch, she wanted the octopus. After some discussion, she asked if I could make a seahorse watch. I was immediately fascinated by the idea and could almost see it. I was sure that a seahorse was on my long list of watches that I wanted to make. I saw it in a rectangular case, to allow it to be longer. At the time, I didn’t have rectangular cases, only round. I was so inspired but her story that I ordered new cases and began down a road designed to open me up and set a new precedent. The design took months. The seahorse had to be wrapped around seaweed and I wanted fish companions close by. To make the perfect seahorse, I needed to know what they ate, why they existed, how they get away from predators and what was important to them. Life in the sea is harsh and running from predators is an everyday occurrence. There is vulnerability in being so little. But I also believe that in that vulnerability, we can sometimes find our greatest strength. How does a horse, so little, survive? To be truly delicate, yet tough. Beautiful and so different. No one around them looks like them, acts like them, or thinks like them. Where do they get their courage? To be vulnerable means that you see the world differently. You might hide in the shadows. You might always keep seaweed around you to obscure your position or possibly, to add comfort. When you know that at any moment, if you turn your back, your fish neighbor might eat you. I am a seahorse, I am small, I am vulnerable, I am different, and yet, I am here, living my truth in my own way. I will not conform, this is who I am. Case size: Rectangular Band size: 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Wind Chaser
watches.description: This Wind Chaser timepiece embodies the thrill of open water and the courage to face the elements. The sailboat leans into the wind, chasing the horizon as waves swell and storm clouds gather. It’s a tribute to those whose hearts will always belong to the ocean. The stormy sky is crafted from rich brown Mother of Pearl, while the sails glow in luminous white Mother of Pearl. The boat is shaped from warm maple wood, with a hull of glossy black-lip abalone. The water shimmers in traditional Paua abalone, tinted deep ocean blue, capturing the movement and energy of the sea. BACKSTORY For a few years in my mid 20's, I lived on a sailboat in the San Francisco Bay. It was a magical time, full of adventure and challenge. We were young, strong, and loved to push our limits. The San Francisco Bay was an intense training ground and also a great place to meet other sailers who had incredible seafaring stories to tell. We sailed every every chance we got, playing in the white caps of the bay. Like every live-aboard, we soon wanted to take a few years off and cruise the South Pacific. We dreamt of making the loop from SF to Costa Rice, over to Australia, up to Micronesia, then Japan, over to Hawaii and back home. We were finally ready - we equipped our boat, paid off our bills and began to get open-ocean experience by bringing racing yachts back to San Francisco from Mexico. After two successful trips, we were hired to bring a beautiful Swedish built Swan 44 up the coast. But things didn't go as planned. It was a harrowing trip that changed the trajectory of my life. Obviously, Mother Nature had other plans for me. In San Diego I got off that boat, promptly sold my boat, and enrolled in engineering school. Even though my South Pacific trip didn't work out (and I'm ok with that), I still have a love for sailboats and feeling the wind to adjust my course. So, when a family member asked me to create a sailboat watch for her son, my eyes got wide and I jumped at the chance!

watches.name: Octopus
watches.description: The octopus is one of the ocean’s most extraordinary engineers, combining intelligence, adaptability, and strength in ways few creatures can. As beautifully captured in My Octopus Teacher , even a gentle encounter reveals just how strong, aware, and intentional an octopus can be. Eight arms, endless curiosity, and a mind always at work, the octopus can solve puzzles, escape mazes, and make it look effortless. Dial Composition The dial is meticulously composed of 22 individual pieces of abalone shell. Blue-tinted abalone forms the ocean backdrop, while blonde-tinted abalone brings the octopus itself to life, creating depth, contrast, and movement across the surface. This dial was proudly featured on the cover of The Horological Times , celebrating its artistry and technical achievement in fine watchmaking. Available in 35mm or 38mm sizes.

watches.name: Arctic Wild - Polar Bear
watches.description: Backstory - A few years ago I had a dream that I was stuck in a dark little shack that was floating out to sea. It had no windows and I didn’t know where I was or how I got there. Suddenly, out of a hole in the floor, a polar bear’s head popped up through the floor and it looked right at me. I was worried at first but it had such warm and friendly eyes that I decided, without question, to follow it. I knew it would help me. I dove down into the ocean and found I was able to breathe underwater when I was swimming with it. Eventually, I made it to land feeling confident and protected. Ever since then, when I need extra strength to get through a hard time, I think of the polar bear and the awe inspiring power of its presence. ~ Celeste Wong To celebrate and bring awareness to this majestic endangered species, this Arctic Wild Polar Bear watch is available in two background styles. Choose from a Tahitian abalone sky that resembles the arctic tundra or a Northern Lights background. Dial Composition The polar bear is crafted from luminous Mother of Pearl, with sparkle Mother of Pearl adding a soft glow along its back. Its feet are formed from green abalone for a touch of natural contrast. The sky shimmers in either Northern Lights Awabi abalone or Tahitian black-lip abalone, while the water below is rendered in blue-tinted Paua abalone. Clear CZ stones glimmer in the sky as time markers, completing the scene with a crisp, icy sparkle. Available in 35mm or 38mm Band sizes: 16mm or 20mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Transformation - Butterfly
watches.description: Change is rarely comfortable, but it often brings us closer to who we are. The butterfly has long symbolized transformation, resilience, and the courage to emerge into something new. Delicate yet remarkably strong, it reminds us that growth is part of life’s unfolding. This watch was inspired by change, beauty, and the strength it takes to spread your wings. Dial Composition This design features a handcrafted butterfly wing cut from anodized aluminum and carefully inlaid into iridescent mother of pearl. The shell around the wing catches the light with soft flashes of color, bringing depth and life to the dial. Clear CZ stones mark the hours like small points of light across the surface. Case size: 30mm Band size: 12mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Awareness - Dragonfly
watches.description: Dragonflies are a reminder to be present and aware. They live fully in the moment because their time in flight is brief, only a few months of shimmering freedom after years spent beneath the surface as nymphs. Their short, brilliant lives encourage us to slow down, notice where we are, and move with intention. Awareness brings clarity: knowing who you are, what you want, and making choices that honor both. Dial Composition The iridescent and sparkly white shell on the dial is Mother of Pearl. Mother of Pearl can have hues of purple, pink and green within it. The most common shimmery color is pink but shell is an organic material so the variation in shades is impossible to predict. The dragonfly wings are finely cut metal pieces inlaid in the Mother of Pearl background. Clear cubic zirconia stones that reflect the light and set off the dial are used as time markers. A true work of art, this timepiece sparkles in the sun, allowing you to be in the moment and soak up the wisdom of a creature who must make the most of every second. Available in 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz

watches.name: Bee's Knees
watches.description: Yes, bees really do have knees. Small but mighty, the honey bee moves through the world carrying pollen from flower to flower, doing essential work along the way. Known for cooperation and tireless effort, bees are powerful symbols of community and shared purpose. They give us honey, one of nature’s sweetest and most nourishing foods, and play a vital role as the planet’s most important pollinators. This watch celebrates the honey bee’s outsized impact and reminds us that even the smallest creatures can make the biggest difference. Dial Composition The dial features a honey bee crafted from yellow and mosaic abalone for the body, with wings formed from pink heart abalone. The flowers are rendered in either orange Paua abalone or soft yellow golden Mother of Pearl, offering two natural color variations. Mother of Pearl surrounds the scene, creating a luminous backdrop. Either way, the bee is busy harvesting pollen for a fruitful year ahead. Available in 35mm Band size: 16mm Swiss Quartz
